title: BatchFacts
description: JSON map of number-keyed facts returned by a Numbers API batch request. Each value is either a plain-text fact (default) or a Fact object (when `json` is set).

example.1: 1 is the number of dimensions of a line.
example.2: 2 is the number of polynucleotide strands in a DNA double helix.
example.3: 3 is the number of sets needed to be won to win the whole match in volleyball.
example.10: 10 is the highest score possible in Olympics gymnastics competitions.
